artContract.purpose: One gameplay-oriented opaque cave concept, preserving approved art direction.
artContract.seams: No seamless tile or shared-edge requirement.
artContract.shapePrecision: Readable solid terrain, excavated recess and footholds; no exact movement, collision or grid identity claim.
artContract.reason: Large scene concept benefits from built-in generation. This is not low-resolution tile production.
artContract.limits: Hidden ore must remain hidden. No new item, damage, light-sharing or cooperation rule is specified. Generated lighting and mining poses are illustrative.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-bleed landscape 1536x864 GAMEPLAY-ORIENTED concept image for Dark Nights, a 2D side-view cooperative mining game. Image 1 is the approved visual style, NOT a layout to copy. Preserve its clean slightly irregular dark ink contours, broad grey-brown rock faces, restrained simple flat shading, cyan-blue background layering and friendly pale-cyan original hero. Image 2 fixes character identity: enormous round pale-cyan hood, warm cream oval face with minimal black features, tiny slender cyan torso and thin short limbs. Do not redesign clothes or add helmets, backpacks or jetpacks. TWO small characters of this original design, approximately 80 pixels tall at 864px canvas height, one mining and one nearby companion, not portraits. MAIN SCENE: an intimate asymmetric underground passage that arrives from the left, gently slopes down, and ends in a small working alcove excavated into the solid RIGHT wall. The mining hero stands feet firmly on the alcove floor near center-right, facing right, using a simple short-handled pickaxe against a freshly exposed wall within arm reach. The working alcove extends about two character widths into the wall and is about two character heights tall: a visibly bite-shaped irregular recess, small stepped notches and fresh lighter edge cuts, not a giant prebuilt room. Show only a few modest ochre-gold ore flecks embedded FLUSH in the freshly exposed face and one small broken vein segment truncated by opaque rock. The rest of the ore body is completely hidden inside solid opaque terrain: absolutely NO x-ray, translucent wall, full exposed vein diagram or giant protruding crystal clusters. A few small angular chips lie directly under the working face. The companion is on the approach a few body widths behind, holding a small simple flashlight pointed toward the mining face. Clearly visible but restrained directional light falls across the local working wall and floor, with a little soft reflected light. No helmet lamps or blazing laser beam. Use subdued ambient blue so unlit terrain remains faintly readable, and the approved clean grey-brown flat art is clearly visible inside the lit area. Do not make the entire image black or uniformly bright. The ceiling is low and uneven, with broad overhangs and occasional blunt points; solid rock fills much of the upper and right frame. In the upper left-middle, a modest irregular side opening behind a rock rib suggests another route, partly occluded, with NO visible treasure behind it. The foreground floor alternates exposed grey bedrock and discontinuous thin sandy patches, not a continuous yellow paved highway. Terrain should invite excavation, not platform jumping. Distant blue cave silhouettes appear only through the left passage and side opening; behind the newly dug alcove is a close quiet dark blue-grey rock backwall, NOT a bottomless blue abyss. Strong separation of solid foreground rock, excavated cavity, noncolliding backwall and distant space. Sparse broad cracks in large rock masses, fresh local excavation cuts clearly distinguishable from decorative cracks. Strict orthographic SIDE-VIEW 2D platformer projection; no isometric or receding perspective road. Composition tells 'notice an ore trace, dig into the wall, uncover a little more, decide whether to continue' without captions. Preserve the friendly simple art of reference 1 while making exploration and mining legible. No HUD, diagrams, arrows, labels, text, border, watermark, loot bags, buildings, ladders, ropes, monsters, invented tools, photorealism, 3D, crosshatching or noisy texture. A single cohesive in-game-style scene, not a multi-panel sheet and not a production screenshot.
